title: Synthetic example: The Seed in the Cup

seed-book.plan: Two spreads separate read-aloud text from illustration directions. This fixture contains no generated images.

children.title: A Small Beginning
children.brief: A child plants a seed in a cup.

children.title: A New Leaf
children.brief: A sprout appears in the same cup.

seed-1.plan: Use one brief sentence and a clear illustration brief.
seed-1.draft:
### Read aloud
One small seed. One small cup.

### Illustration brief
A red cup of soil on a low windowsill. A child places a single seed in the soil. These are directions, not a finished illustration.

seed-2.plan: Show the sprout visually without describing every detail in the read-aloud line.
seed-2.draft:
### Read aloud
Good morning, little one.

### Illustration brief
The same red cup and windowsill. A tiny green sprout leans toward the sunlight. No illustration file has been generated.
